files.role: TaskTracker task router — modified in-place; no new files created

public_objects.name: _preference_client
public_objects.purpose: Returns a configured httpx.Client targeting PREFERENCE_STORE_URL

fields.name: label_ids
fields.purpose: Ordered list of label IDs to persist as the active filter selection

public_objects.name: list_used_labels
public_objects.purpose: GET /labels/used — proxies LabelEngine GET /api/labels/used?object_type=task; returns Dataset or empty Dataset on failure

public_objects.name: get_label_filter_preference
public_objects.purpose: GET /preferences/label_filter — proxies PreferenceStore GET /api/preferences/tasktracker.task-list/label_filter; passes through Dataset or 404 ApiError

public_objects.name: put_label_filter_preference
public_objects.purpose: PUT /preferences/label_filter — proxies PreferenceStore PUT /api/preferences/tasktracker.task-list/label_filter with { value: body.label_ids }; returns 200 or ApiError

removals.name: list_active_labels
removals.reason: Sprint07 workaround; replaced by list_used_labels proxying LabelEngine /api/labels/used

removals.name: label_ids
removals.reason: Was never implemented server-side; client-side filtering is sufficient and declared as the canonical approach

files.role: TaskTracker frontend — modified in-place; label filter wiring extracted from fetchTasks and moved to mount-time effects

public_objects.name: TasksPage

state_changes.loaded_by: useEffect on mount: apiFetch('/tasks/labels/used'); rows mapped to TaskLabel[]

state_changes.init: new Set() — replaced by mount effect
state_changes.loaded_by: useEffect (after availableLabels known): apiFetch('/tasks/preferences/label_filter'); on 200 parse value field as JSON string[], intersect with availableLabels IDs; on 404/error use all availableLabels IDs

effect_changes.name: saveFilterPreference
effect_changes.action: apiFetch('/tasks/preferences/label_filter', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ label_ids: Array.from(selectedLabelIds) }) }); fire-and-forget

removals_from_fetchTasks: for (const task of rows) { for (const label of task.labels ?? []) { seen.set(label.id, label); } }
